verdict.rationale: Xero markets JAX, an AI assistant that reconciles transactions, extracts bill data, and enables plain-language invoicing, plus 'instant answers' on cash flow and financial health, suggesting some AI-generated insight capability. However, evidence is mostly vendor marketing copy with no independent/community validation of insight quality, and much of the 'AI toolkit' evidence (MCP server, SDKs) is developer-facing infrastructure rather than end-user insights.
